# PathPort (https://getpathport.com)

> PathPort is the individual professional's portable, sovereign living identity and evidence record. Own your journey. Shape what’s next. Manage your canonical record once, present tailored portfolios anywhere, track multi-state continuing education, and power your career advancement with whole-journey AI intelligence.

## The 6 Action Pillars of PathPort
PathPort models professional capability across six balanced dimensions:
1. **Earn (Credentials & Board Licenses)**: State multi-state licenses, board specialties, and tamper-evident digital credentials (RN, NP, NREMT, FP-C, PMP).
2. **Learn (Continuing Education & Accredited Topics)**: Mandatory contact hours, state topic buckets (e.g., Florida Medical Errors, California Implicit Bias, Texas Jurisprudence), and 60-hr NCCP / 60-PDU cycles.
3. **Build (Applied Deliverables & Toolkits)**: Clinical protocols, simulation curriculums, technical architectures, EHR order sets, and open-source repositories.
4. **Demonstrate (Structured Case Studies)**: Verifiable Challenge-Approach-Outcome work proofs with measured clinical and financial metrics.
5. **Experience (Operational Roles & Preceptorship)**: Inpatient charge leadership, flight hours, FTO coaching, clinical rotations, and program governance.
6. **Reflect (Leadership Philosophy & Incident Debriefs)**: Patient advocacy narratives, Crew Resource Management debriefs, and crisis management frameworks.

## PathAI Whole-Journey Intelligence
Unlike generic credential tools that perform simplistic badge clustering (e.g., suggesting more bedside modules just because an RN badge exists), PathAI understands the whole human journey. It evaluates clinical tenure, committee leadership, and personal career intent to map deterministic qualification roadmaps toward advanced practice, health informatics, flight critical care, or executive leadership.

## Core Capabilities
- **Individual Record Sovereignty**: 100% owned by the individual professional. Credentials, CEUs, case studies, and portfolios stay with you regardless of employer changes or state relocations.
- **Multi-State CE & License Renewal Tracker**: Automatic state-by-state compliance tracking across all 50 states and eNLC compact rules with 30/60/90-day renewal radar alerts.
- **Structured Case Study Builder**: Turns clinical quality rollouts, technical deliverables, and engineering projects into structured Challenge-Action-Metric proof narratives.
- **Living Shareable Portfolios**: Instant permissioned links (`https://getpathport.com/p/yourname`) tailored for hiring managers, faculty appointments, travel agencies, or credentialing committees.
- **PathAI Career & Transition Advisor**: Deterministic gap analysis and learning pathway recommendations for adjacent career transitions.
- **Privacy Firewalls (PathPort Workplace - Late 2026)**: Employers receive scoped consent verification for active role compliance without accessing private career history or unshared records.

## Pricing & Free Trial Policy
- **PathPort Essentials ($9.99/mo or $8.33/mo billed annually)**: Sovereign professional record, credentials, degrees, projects, multi-state CE tracking, exam renewal alerts, document vault, and 1 active portfolio link.
- **PathPort Pro ($19.99/mo or $16.66/mo billed annually)**: Everything in Essentials plus MyPath 6-pillar career growth intelligence, target opportunity gap analysis, Story Bank, and unlimited tailored portfolios.
- **Free Trial Policy (No Payment Info Required)**: PathPort does not offer an ad-supported or data-brokered free tier to protect individual privacy. Every standard individual account receives a 14-day free trial of PathPort Pro with no payment info required. Founding members who join the waitlist receive an exclusive 30-day free trial of Pro for the Fall 2026 launch.
- **PathPort Workplace (Launching Late 2026)**: Scoped workforce credential compliance radar, automated expiration tracking, and privacy-preserving employee offboarding.
- **PathPort Certify (Launching Late 2026)**: Automated topic audit calculation engine, reviewer queue management, and authoritative provenance badge issuance.
